skills.name: Basic Attack: Penultimate
skills.description:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launch up to four strikes forward, dealing Physical DMG and Electric DMG.
During the 3rd hit, repeatedly press [Basic Attack] to continue the attack, continuously striking the enemy. Using Dodge during this period will not interrupt Qingyi's Basic Attack combo count.
During the 3rd hit, stop pressing [Basic Attack] to interrupt the continuous attack, transitioning automatically to the 4th hit. If the continuous attack lasts for a certain time, the 4th hit will be enhanced.
Anti-Interrupt Level is increased and DMG received is reduced by 40% during the 3rd and 4th hit.

skills.name: Basic Attack: Enchanted Blossoms
skills.description:
Hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launches a forward rush attack, dealing Electric DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: Flash Connect
skills.description: When Qingyi deals Electric DMG with a skill, she accumulates Flash Connect Voltage. When Flash Connect Voltage reaches 75%, she will enter the Flash Connect state. When using her Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms, Qingyi will consume all Flash Connect Voltage and exit the Flash Connect state. For every 1% of Flash Connect Voltage consumed over 75%, her Damage and Daze inflicted by this skill will be increased by 1%/0.5%. Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms itself does not accumulate Flash Connect Voltage.

skills.name: Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms
skills.description:
During the Flash Connect state, hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launch five consecutive forward rush attacks, then execute a Finishing Move that inflicts massive Electric DMG. Release [Basic Attack] during the move to trigger the Finishing Move early.
Activate the Finishing Move just before the character is attacked to trigger Perfect Dodge.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased and DMG received is reduced by 40% during the rush attack. Qingyi is invulnerable during the Finishing Move.

skills.name: Special Attack: Sunlit Glory
skills.description:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Quickly swings upward, followed by a downward smash, dealing Electric DMG.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

skills.name: EX Special Attack: Moonlit Begonia
skills.description:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Quickly swings upward and leaps into the air, turning around to launch a series of attacks, then follows up with a powerful downward smash, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Hold [EX Special Attack] to consume additional energy to increase the number of hits of the series of attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After executing the move, you can immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of a Basic Attack.

skills.name: Dodge: Swan Song
skills.description:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Dash Attack: Breach
skills.description:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Dodge to activate:
Rush forward and then launch an upward attack, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: Dodge Counter: Lingering Sentiments
skills.description:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Leap into the air and then perform a downward attack, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Chain Attack: Tranquil Serenade
skills.description:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launch a series of powerful strikes over a large area in front, dealing massive Electric DMG
When this attack hits an enemy, the skill's DMG increases by 3% for every stack of Subjugation in Core Passive: Eternal Seasons the target has.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Ultimate: Eight Sounds of Ganzhou
skills.description:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Launch a series of powerful strikes over a large area in front, followed by a Finishing Move, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Quick Assist: Wind Through the Pines
skills.description:
When the active character is launched, press [Assist] to activate:
Leap into the air and perform a downward attack, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Defensive Assist: Graceful Embellishment
skills.description:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Assist] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Assist Follow-Up: Song of the Clear River
skills.description:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Rush forward with an attack and inject electrical energy into the ground, then pull back to trigger an explosion, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Core Passive: Eternal Seasons
skills.description: When Qingyi lands a Finishing Move on an enemy with her Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms, it applies 5 stacks of Subjugation to the enemy, stacking up to 20 times. Each stack of Subjugation increases the target's Stun DMG Multiplier by 4%. For each rush attack performed during Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms, the Finishing Move will apply an extra stack of Subjugation. If Perfect Dodge is triggered when using the Finishing Move, it directly applies {CAL:5+5,1,2} stacks of Subjugation. When applying Subjugation to normal and elite enemies, the target receives double the stacks. When the target recovers from being Stunned, the corresponding stacks of Subjugation are reset.

skills.name: Additional Ability: Three Verses of Farewell at Yang Pass
skills.description:
When another character in your squad is an Attack character or shares the same Faction:
Basic Attacks deal 20% increased Daze. If Qingyi's Impact is greater than 120, each point over increases her ATK by 6, up to a maximum of 600.

mindscapes.name: Insulation Breakdown
mindscapes.description: When Qingyi enters combat, Flash Connect Voltage is instantly restored to its maximum, and the accumulation rate is increased by 30%. When using her Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms, if Flash Connect Voltage is at its maximum, the attack will reduce the DEF of the enemy it hits by 15%, and Qingyi's CRIT Rate against that enemy will increase by 20% for 15s.

mindscapes.name: Minimal Effort, Maximum Impact
mindscapes.description: The Stun DMG Multiplier increase provided by each stack of Subjugation in Core Passive: Eternal Seasons increases to 135% of its original value. When Qingyi's attack hits an enemy and the stacks of Subjugation she applies reaches its maximum stacks, her Daze dealt to the target increases by 15%.

mindscapes.name: Drink Hot Water
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

mindscapes.name: Stable Arc Barrier
mindscapes.description: Upon entering or exiting Flash Connect state, gain a shield equal to 10% of Qingyi's Max HP. If a previous shield is still active when the shield effect refreshes, Qingyi generates 5 Energy. This Energy Generation effect can be triggered once every 10s.

mindscapes.name: Youthful Spirit
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

mindscapes.name: Eight Meridians
mindscapes.description: The Interrupt Level of Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms is greatly increased, and the CRIT DMG is increased by an additional 100%. When Qingyi hits an enemy with her Basic Attack: Enchanted Moonlit Blossoms, the target's Attribute DMG RES is reduced by 20% for 15s.
